entities.summary: Erna W. Mohr was a German zoologist who made contributions to ichthyology and mammalogy. Mohr was long associated with the Zoological Museum Hamburg, where she was successively head of the Fish Biology Department, Department of Higher Vertebrates, and Curator of the Vertebrate Department. She was a member of the Academy of Sciences Leopoldina and held an honorary doctorate from the University of Munich. Erna Mohr was a writers & intellectuals from Hamburg (1894-07-11, Hamburg–1968-09-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
